title: Microsoft Teams: Image viewer improvements enable scrolling and jumping to original message
description: Lightbox enhancements let users scroll through all previously shared images in a conversation, provide a clearer visual focus on the image being viewed, and add a header option that jumps directly to the original message where the image was posted.
